name: node-engine-guard
description: Codex SessionStart hook that checks non-interactive node against package.json engines.node.

interface.shortDescription: Warn when Codex sees a node version that does not satisfy package.json engines.node.
interface.longDescription: Adds a Codex SessionStart hook that verifies the actual non-interactive node on PATH against the current project's package.json engines.node range. Useful when interactive shells use nvm or aliases but agent subprocesses resolve a different node.
